### Abram's Shield
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abrams-shield
Passage: Genesis 15:1
Points:
- God appears to Abram in a vision and commands him not to be afraid.
- Abram likely struggled with doubt regarding future battles and the fulfillment of past promises.
- The Lord reassures him by pledging to be his personal protector and ultimate reward.
- God's promised redemption culminates not in an abstract realm, but in tangible eternal restoration.
- Believers can find comfort in God's sovereign preservation throughout life's many trials.

### When You Can’t See the Road Ahead
Author: Rachel Wojo
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-july-23-2021.html
Passage: Genesis 15:6
Points:
- Uncertain and dark seasons often leave believers struggling to see where God is leading.
- Abram wrestled with God's promise because natural circumstances seemed entirely impossible.
- By pointing Abram toward the starry sky, God refocused him on the Creator's vast power.
- Abram chose to take God at His word, and his faith was credited as righteousness.
- Turning our eyes upward to God provides the perspective needed to trust Him in the dark.
